ai.prompt:
You are an assistant for creating educational quizzes. You must generate an Excel file (.xlsx) compatible with the SAVINT platform.

The file must contain 6 sheets, one for each question type. Use EXACTLY the sheet names and column names indicated below.

---

📋 SHEET 1: "Scelta Multipla"
Columns: Domanda | Tempo (sec) | Punti | Confidenza (S/N) | Opzione1 | Opzione2 | Opzione3 | Opzione4 | Opzione5 | Opzione6 | Corretta

- From 2 to 6 options per question
- "Corretta" indicates the number of the correct option (e.g. "1" or "1,3" if more than one is correct)
- Time in seconds (default: 30), Points (default: 1000), Confidence: S or N (default: N)

📋 SHEET 2: "Vero o Falso"
Columns: Domanda | Tempo (sec) | Punti | Confidenza (S/N) | Risposta (V/F)

- Answer: "V" for true, "F" for false

📋 SHEET 3: "Risposta Aperta"
Columns: Domanda | Tempo (sec) | Punti | Confidenza (S/N) | Risposta1 | Risposta2 | Risposta3

- Enter the accepted answers (comparison is case-insensitive)
- At least one answer is required

📋 SHEET 4: "Ordinamento"
Columns: Domanda | Tempo (sec) | Punti | Confidenza (S/N) | Elemento1 | Elemento2 | Elemento3 | Elemento4 | Elemento5 | Elemento6

- Enter the elements IN THE CORRECT ORDER (from 2 to 6 elements)
- The platform will shuffle them automatically during the quiz

📋 SHEET 5: "Stima Numerica"
Columns: Domanda | Tempo (sec) | Punti | Confidenza (S/N) | Valore Corretto | Tolleranza | Range Massimo | Unità

- Correct Value: the exact number
- Tolerance: margin within which the score is full
- Maximum Range: beyond this margin the score is zero
- Unit: optional (e.g. "km", "millions", "°C")

📋 SHEET 6: "Abbinamenti"
Columns: Domanda | Tempo (sec) | Punti | Confidenza (S/N) | Sinistra1 | Destra1 | Sinistra2 | Destra2 | Sinistra3 | Destra3 | Sinistra4 | Destra4

- Enter matching pairs side by side (Sinistra1-Destra1 is the first pair, etc.)
- Minimum 2 pairs, maximum 4
- The platform will shuffle the right-side elements during the quiz

---

IMPORTANT RULES:
- The first row of each sheet MUST be the header with the exact column names
- The second row is an example (it will be ignored during import)
- Question data starts from row 3
- The Time, Points and Confidence columns are optional (defaults will be used)
- Empty sheets are ignored, you don't need to fill them all
- Generate the .xlsx file, NOT a .csv file

Now create a quiz on the topic: [TOPIC]
Target audience: [TARGET, e.g. primary school, middle school, high school (first two years), high school (last three years), university, adult education]
Language for questions and answers: [LANGUAGE, e.g. Italian, English, French...]

Adapt the difficulty level, language and complexity of the questions to the indicated target. Generate at least 10 questions distributed across different types. Use a mix of difficulty appropriate to the level. Write ALL questions, answer options and answers in the indicated language.

questionHelp.multipleChoiceDesc: The student chooses one or more answers from the proposed options. You can have 2 to 6 options and more than one can be correct.
questionHelp.multipleChoiceEditor: Click the circle next to each option to mark it as correct.
questionHelp.multipleChoicePlayer: The student sees 4 colored buttons and taps the answer.
questionHelp.multipleChoiceScoring: Correct if they select exactly the right answers. Score based on speed.
questionHelp.multipleChoiceExample: What is the capital of Italy?
questionHelp.trueFalseDesc: The student chooses between True and False. The simplest and fastest question.
questionHelp.trueFalseEditor: Click True or False to set the correct answer.
questionHelp.trueFalsePlayer: The student sees two large buttons: True and False.
questionHelp.trueFalseExample: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
questionHelp.openAnswerDesc: The student writes the answer freely. You can specify multiple accepted answers (e.g. synonyms).
questionHelp.openAnswerEditor: Add all acceptable variants (e.g. 'Rome', 'rome', 'ROME'). Comparison is case-insensitive.
questionHelp.openAnswerPlayer: The student sees a text field and a Submit button.
questionHelp.openAnswerScoring: Correct if the text matches one of the accepted answers (case-insensitive). Score based on speed.
questionHelp.openAnswerExample: What is Earth's natural satellite called?
questionHelp.orderingDesc: The student must put the elements in the correct order. Useful for sequences, processes, timelines.
questionHelp.orderingEditor: Enter the elements in the correct order. The system will shuffle them automatically for the student.
questionHelp.orderingPlayer: The student sees the elements in random order and uses up/down arrows to reorder them.
questionHelp.orderingScoring: Correct if the final order matches the set order. Score based on speed.
questionHelp.orderingExample: Order the planets from the Sun: Mars, Earth, Venus, Mercury
questionHelp.matchingDesc: The student connects elements from the left column with those from the right column. The right column is shuffled.
questionHelp.matchingEditor: Enter the pairs: the left element will be fixed, the right one will be shuffled.
questionHelp.matchingPlayer: The student taps an element on the left, then the corresponding one on the right to create the match.
questionHelp.matchingScoring: Correct if all matches are right. Score based on speed.
questionHelp.matchingExample: Match each capital to its country
questionHelp.matchingAnswer: Rome → Italy, Paris → France, Berlin → Germany
questionHelp.spotErrorDesc: The student must identify lines that contain errors in text or code. There can be more than one error to find.
questionHelp.spotErrorEditor: Write the lines of text/code. Click the line number to mark it as error (turns red). You can add an optional explanation.
questionHelp.spotErrorPlayer: The student sees numbered lines and taps those they think are wrong. They can select more than one.
questionHelp.spotErrorScoring: Partial score: each error found is worth points, each wrong selection removes points (minimum 0). Speed bonus applied to total.
questionHelp.spotErrorExample: Find the lines with errors in the Python code:
questionHelp.spotErrorAnswer:
Line 1: print("Hello") → OK
Line 2: for i in range(10) → OK
Line 3: x = 5 / 0 → ERROR
Line 4: return x → OK
questionHelp.numericEstimationDesc: The student enters a number. The score depends on how close it is to the correct value.
questionHelp.numericEstimationEditor: Set the correct value, tolerance (full score) and maximum range (zero points). You can add a unit of measure.
questionHelp.numericEstimationPlayer: The student sees a numeric field and the optional unit of measure.
questionHelp.numericEstimationScoring: Full score within tolerance. Decreasing partial score up to maximum range. Zero beyond range.
questionHelp.numericEstimationExample: How many km are there between Rome and Milan?
questionHelp.numericEstimationAnswer:
Correct value: 572 km
Tolerance: ±30 km (full score: 542-602)
Maximum range: ±200 km (zero points beyond 772 or below 372)
questionHelp.imageHotspotDesc: The student taps the correct point on an image. Useful for anatomy, geography, technical diagrams.
questionHelp.imageHotspotEditor: Upload an image, then click to position the hotspot (the correct point). Use the sliders to adjust radius and tolerance.
questionHelp.imageHotspotPlayer: The student sees the image and taps where they think the correct point is.
questionHelp.imageHotspotScoring: Full score if the tap falls within the radius. Partial score in the tolerance zone. Zero outside.
questionHelp.imageHotspotExample: Tap the heart in the anatomical diagram
questionHelp.imageHotspotAnswer:
The correct area is a circle centered on the heart.
Tap inside the circle = full score.
Tap nearby = partial score.
questionHelp.codeCompletionDesc: The student completes a missing line of code. They can answer with multiple choice or by writing the code.
questionHelp.codeCompletionEditor: Write the code block and select the line to hide (by clicking the number). Choose whether the student answers with multiple choice or free text.
questionHelp.codeCompletionPlayer: The student sees the code with a missing line (???) and chooses from options or writes the answer.
questionHelp.codeCompletionScoring: Multiple choice: correct/wrong. Free text: normalized comparison (ignores case and extra spaces). Speed bonus.

hubHome.heroSubtitle: SAVINT is the open-source interactive quiz platform for schools: free, libre and built on sharing. Teachers create quizzes, play them in class and make them available to everyone.
hubHome.searchPlaceholder: Search a quiz by subject, topic…
hubHome.schoolBody: Install SAVINT on your own servers and connect it to savint.it to search, download and publish quizzes. Or try it right now without installing anything.
hubHome.whyOpenBody: Free code (AGPL-3.0), public on GitHub. Anyone can inspect it, improve it and adapt it to their school.
hubHome.whyFreeBody: No subscriptions, ads or data selling. Born for schools, it stays free for everyone.
hubHome.whySchoolBody: Designed for the classroom: many question types, practice mode for individual study and statistics for the teacher.
hubHome.whyShareBody: Every published quiz is an experience other teachers can reuse, clone and improve. Knowledge grows when it circulates.
hubHome.howStep1Body: Browse quizzes made by teachers and try them right in your browser, no sign-up needed.
hubHome.howStep2Body: Start a live game: students join with a PIN from their phones, game-show style.
hubHome.howStep3Body: Create your own quizzes and publish them on the hub: your experience becomes a starting point for other classes.
hubHome.registerIntro: You don't need an account to search, try and play quizzes. Sign up when you want to contribute:
hubHome.registerPublishBody: Share them on the hub with teachers everywhere.
hubHome.registerProfileBody: A page collecting your quizzes, ready to share with colleagues and students.
hubHome.registerSchoolBody: Publish and download quizzes right from your installation's dashboard.
hubHome.footer: SAVINT is free software (AGPL-3.0), written by Cristian Virgili with the help of Claude.

install.title: Install SAVINT at your school
install.subtitle: SAVINT is a self-hostable interactive quiz platform: install it on your own servers, keep student data at your school, and connect to savint.it to share quizzes with other teachers.
install.prop1Body: SAVINT is and always will be free for all schools, with no license fees or subscriptions.
install.prop2Body: The code is public on GitHub: you can study it, modify it, and contribute to the project.
install.prop3Body: Self-hosted means quiz and student data live on your server, not on external clouds.
install.step1Body: All you need is a server (VPS or on-premise) with Docker and Docker Compose installed.
install.step2Body: Use the official compose file: the image is pre-configured and ready to use.
install.step3Body: Point a domain to the server and configure HTTPS with a reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx + Certbot).
install.step4Body: From the instance panel, connect it to savint.it to publish and download quizzes from the community.
install.finalBody: SAVINT is free software (AGPL-3.0): download, install and bring interactive quizzes to your school.

statistiche.perEsercizioDescrizione: For each exercise in the assignment: how many enrolled students completed it, how many started it without finishing, and the average score of those who completed it (on their best attempt).
statistiche.completatiValoreAssegnato: {completati} (assigned to {assegnatoA, plural, one {# student} other {# students}})
statistiche.andamentoDescrizione: All assignments given to the class (withdrawn ones excluded), grouped by topic. The topic where the class is weakest comes first. Only currently enrolled students count.
statistiche.andamentoRiepilogo: {compiti, plural, one {# assignment} other {# assignments}}, {iscritti, plural, one {# enrolled student} other {# enrolled students}}
statistiche.nessunCompito: This class has no assignments yet.

figura.segnaposto: {tipo} with measures {misure}: it appears in the preview, with drawn values.

diagramma.segnaposto: {tipo} with the values of {valori}: it appears in the preview, with drawn data.

grafico.descrizione: Graph of a function for x from {da} to {a}
grafico.segnaposto: Graph of y = {espressione}, for x from {da} to {a}: it appears in the preview, with drawn values.

redazione.suggerimentoAiuto: Shown to the student after a wrong answer.

variabili.spiegazioneVar: To show a variable's value, write \var followed by the name in curly braces, as in the example below; inside a simplify command, variables are instead written on their own in curly braces, without \var in front.
variabili.spiegazioneOrdine: The order you write the variables in below doesn't matter: the engine works out on its own which ones depend on which.
variabili.erroreNome: Must be a valid name: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.
variabili.erroreDefinizione: This variable is missing its definition.
variabili.nessuna: No variables: the exercise will always ask the same question.
variabili.condizioneAiuto: An expression that must be true for a combination of variables to be accepted, for example "a <> b". Leave it empty if you don't need one.

campoJme.ambiguo: The formula contains «{segno}»: the engine would silently keep only one of the two solutions. Write the two solutions as two separate formulas, or type the formula straight into the field.
campoJme.nomeSconosciuto: «{nome}» is not a variable of this exercise, and the engine would read it as a multiplication. If you meant a function, write it with brackets: {nome}(x). Otherwise declare the variable in the panel, or type the formula straight into the field.
campoJme.nomeComeFunzione: Written this way, «{nome}(…)» is a call to a function named «{nome}», which the engine does not have. If you meant a multiplication, write it with an asterisk: {nome}*(…). Or type the formula straight into the field.
campoJme.nonCompila: The engine cannot read this formula: {dettaglio}. You can fix it here, or type it straight into the field.
campoJme.vuoto: No formula comes out of this drawing: either it is still empty, or it is written in a shape that cannot be converted (an overline, for instance). Write it here another way, or type the formula straight into the field.

campoTesto.formulaSciolta: This looks like a formula written outside \( \): «{formula}». The student would read it character by character, asterisks and carets included: put it between \( and \).
campoTesto.notaSimplify: Inside a simplify command the text stays as written: what comes out of it depends on the drawn numbers, and you can see that in the preview beside.
campoTesto.vuoto: The window is empty: there is no formula to insert. Draw one here, or close the window if you changed your mind.

finestraFormula.descrizione: Write it as you would on paper: when you confirm, it goes back into the field you opened this window from.

parti.tipoSceltaMultipla: Multiple choice with several correct answers

scelta.correttaRimossa: You removed the answer marked correct: choose a new one before saving.

sceltaMultipla.nessunaCorretta: Mark at least one answer as correct before saving.
sceltaMultipla.tuttoONiente: The student gets the marks only by ticking all and only the correct answers: no partial marks.

espressione.spiegazioneConfronto: The engine compares answers symbolically: 2x, x*2 and x+x are treated as the same answer. There's no need to ask the student to simplify the result.

anteprima.vuota: Add a part to see and try the exercise. The preview updates as you write.
anteprima.spiegazione: Try the exercise as a student. Each draw uses different numbers; answers here are not saved.
anteprima.semeRifiuto: Rejected seed: {seme} — the draw that broke the exercise

redazione.confermaUscita: There are unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave without saving?
redazione.verificaOk: No problems found across the twenty test seeds.
redazione.salvataggioBloccatoScelta: Saving is blocked: one or more multiple-choice parts don't have a correct answer chosen yet.

figura.spiegazione: The figure is drawn to scale with each student's values. Write the measures with the exercise variables, separated by commas.
figura.incognite: Show «?» instead of the value of
figura.aiutoTriangolo: the three sides: AB, BC, CA
figura.nonValido: Check the measures: as many expressions as the figure needs, separated by commas, without braces or square brackets.

diagramma.spiegazione: First define the data in Variables, for example data = repeat(random(1..10), 5) and days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]: each student will see the chart with their own data.
diagramma.etichetteAiuto: Without labels the bars or slices are called 1, 2, 3…
diagramma.nonValido: Write a variable name, without braces or square brackets: lists go in Variables.

grafico.titolo: Insert the graph of a function
grafico.spiegazione: Write the function with the exercise variables: each student will see the graph with their own values. The formula is not shown in the graph.
grafico.funzioneAiuto: For example a*x + b, or x^2 - c. Write variables without braces.
grafico.nonValido: Check the function (no braces) and the ranges: the first bound must be less than the second.

immagine.spiegazione: A figure, a diagram or a graph. Write the measures that change for each student in the text, with variables.
immagine.file: File (PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB)
immagine.descrizioneAiuto: What the image shows, in a few words: screen reader users will hear it.
immagine.erroreTipo: This file is not a PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP image.
immagine.erroreGrande: The image is larger than 5 MB: shrink it and try again.
immagine.dentroFormula: Move the cursor outside the formula to insert an image.

erroreSalvataggio.nonRappresentabile: This exercise can't be opened in this editor.
erroreSalvataggio.versioneInConflitto: Someone else saved this exercise in the meantime: reload the page and try again.

incompleto.titolo: Before saving, this is still missing:
incompleto.argomento: the topic (set it by opening «Catalog», at the top);
incompleto.parti: at least one part, i.e. the question the student answers («Add part» button);
incompleto.parte: part {numero} is incomplete: check its prompt, marks and correct answer;
incompleto.variabile: variable {numero} is incomplete: it needs a valid name and a definition;
incompleto.altro: another field is not valid: check the exercise data.

elenco.motivoGenerico: This exercise can't be opened in this editor.
elenco.importati: {importati, plural, =0 {No exercises imported} one {# exercise imported} other {# exercises imported}}{saltati, plural, =0 {.} other {, # skipped (invalid, already present or not saved).}}

importa.spiegazione: Paste the JSON generated by the AI, or upload the .json file. Savint checks every exercise with the same verification as the editor and shows you a preview before importing it.

erroreTesto.vuoto: There are no exercises: paste the JSON generated by the AI.
erroreTesto.non_json: The text is not valid JSON: {dettaglio}
erroreTesto.virgolette: Check the quotes: they must be " and not “ ”.
erroreTesto.troppi: Too many exercises at once: at most {max} per import. Split the file.

importa.erroreFile: The file could not be read.

erroreServer.invalid_body: The request is not valid: check the JSON and try again.
erroreServer.troppo_grande: The JSON is too large (1 MB max): split it into several imports.
erroreServer.rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time: wait a minute and try again.
erroreServer.non_autorizzato: Your session has expired or you lack permission: sign in again as a teacher.
erroreServer.generico: Something went wrong. Please try again.

importa.erroreSalvataggio: Not saved because of a server problem: please try again.
importa.risultato: {importati, plural, one {# exercise imported} other {# exercises imported}}, {nonImportati, plural, other {# not imported}}.
importa.riprova: To try again, press “Check” once more: the exercises already imported will show as “Already present”.
importa.giaNelFile: Repeats the exercise “{titolo}” from this same file
importa.copiaErrore: Copy the error for the AI
importa.saltati: {n, plural, one {# exercise with problems will be skipped.} other {# exercises with problems will be skipped.}}

anteprimaDocente.spiegazione: What you see here is exactly what a student would see: answers you give don't create any attempt and aren't saved anywhere.
anteprimaDocente.senzaVersioneTesto: This exercise doesn't have a saved version yet: there's nothing to preview.

condivisione.spiegazioneArgomento: Applies to all your exercises in this topic, including the ones you write later.
condivisione.spiegazioneRaccolta: Whoever gets the collection also sees the exercises you put in it.
condivisione.erroreCaricamento: Couldn't read the sharing settings. Close and try again.
condivisione.cercaCollega: Search a colleague by name or email
condivisione.nessunaPersona: Not shared with any colleague yet.
condivisione.spiegazioneSolo: Only the people in the list can see it.
condivisione.spiegazioneScuola: Every teacher in the school finds it in the catalogue.
condivisione.indirettoRaccolta: {nome} also sees it through the collection “{dettaglio}”
condivisione.indirettoArgomento: {nome} also sees it through the topic “{dettaglio}”
condivisione.indirettiSpiegazione: This access stays even if you remove the sharing above: to remove it, change the collection or the topic.
condivisione.notaTrasferimento: Topic sharing and collections of the previous owner will no longer apply to this exercise.
condivisione.notaTrasferimentoRaccolta: The collection will go to the new owner, who will be able to edit and share it.
condivisione.erroreDestinatario: One of the chosen colleagues can't receive the share.

commenti.erroreTesto: A comment must be between 1 and 2000 characters.
commenti.erroreNonPermesso: You are not allowed to do this.
commenti.erroreNonTrovato: This comment no longer exists. Reload the page.
commenti.erroreTroppi: Too many actions in a row: wait a minute and try again.
commenti.erroreGenerico: Something went wrong. Please try again.
commenti.contatore: {n, plural, one {# open comment} other {# open comments}}

misurePdp.descrizione: Only compensatory measures, no diagnoses or notes. Only the class's teachers can see them; they are never sent to the student.
misurePdp.erroreTempo: Extra time must be a whole number from 0 to 100.

creazione.spiegazione: A timed test taken in class: students see no corrections or solutions until you publish the results.
creazione.formularioAiuto: PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB
creazione.strumentoSoloPdp: Only students with the PDP measure
creazione.quantiPdp: How many for students with fewer exercises
creazione.quantiPdpEtichetta: How many for students with fewer exercises from {etichetta}
creazione.totale: Test total: {n, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
creazione.conMeno: With fewer exercises: {n, plural, one {# exercise} other {# exercises}}
creazione.pdpVuoto: Students with the “fewer exercises” measure would have no exercises: raise at least one “how many for students with fewer exercises” or untick a “not for PDP”.
creazione.campiNonValidi: Check the points (0.5 to 100, in half points) and how many exercises for students with fewer exercises (0 up to how many you take).
creazione.erroreVerificaNonValida: Check the duration (5 to 300 minutes) and the start time, which must be in the future.
creazione.errorePdpSenzaEsercizi: Students with the “fewer exercises” measure would have no exercises: fix the blocks.
creazione.erroreFormularioNonTrovato: The formula sheet can no longer be found: remove it and upload it again.
creazione.erroreFormularioTipo: The formula sheet must be an image (PNG, JPG, WebP) or a PDF.
creazione.erroreFormularioGrande: The file is too large: 10 MB at most.
creazione.erroreFormularioCaricamento: Could not upload the formula sheet. Try again.

eserciziIngresso.title: Math exercises
eserciziIngresso.intro: Savint exercises are done on your own, at home or in the lab. Every student gets different numbers, answers are checked instantly and the teacher sees the class results right away.
eserciziIngresso.studentText: Sign in with your school account: you'll find your assignments and can practise with every exercise in the catalogue.
eserciziIngresso.studentCode: The first time, enter the class code your teacher gave you.
eserciziIngresso.teacherText: Use ready-made exercises or write new ones, assign them to your classes and check who did them and how well.

studentExercisesUi.assignmentSuccess: Great work, moving to the next exercise.
studentExercisesUi.assignmentCompletionError: We could not save the completion. Please try again.
